component.name: nagios-check
component.description: Run named Nagios plugins on a ctrl-exec agent and return their state and performance data as JSON

components.name: nagios-check
components.description: Agent script (Perl): runs the plugins its nagios-checks.conf maps the caller's check names to

components.name: install.sh
components.description: Installer (bash): puts the script, check_mem and scripts.conf entry in place without overwriting host config; --dry-run reports only

components.name: check_mem
components.description: Nagios plugin (bash): available memory as a percent of total, from /proc/meminfo; installed in /usr/local/lib/nagios/plugins

components.name: nagios-checks
components.description: Dispatcher-side run-jobs job: names the checks per agent and logs one syslog line per check that is not OK

components.name: perl-base
components.description: Core modules only: JSON::PP, POSIX, Time::HiRes, Cwd, Encode, Sys::Hostname

components.name: monitoring-plugins-basic
components.description: The Nagios plugins the checks run (check_disk, check_load, check_procs and others); also monitoring-plugins-standard for check_http, check_ssl and more

components.name: bash
components.description: GNU Bourne Again shell, for the run-jobs job

components.name: bsdutils
components.description: Provides logger(1) for the run-jobs job
